Bill.BriefDescription: Requiring physical activity opportunities every school day.

BillBody.BillTitle: AN ACT Relating to improving the physical health of students;adding a new section to chapter 28A.230 RCW; creating a new section;and providing an effective date.
BillBody.EnactingClause: BE IT ENACTED BY THE LEGISLATURE OF THE STATE OF WASHINGTON:

BillSection.RCWSLText: The legislature finds that good physicalhealth is vital to the overall wellbeing of Washington's youth.Regular physical activity is essential to good physical health, and schools are a logical place for youth to engage in physical activity.It is therefore the intent of the legislature to ensure that duringeach school day students are provided with adequate opportunities toengage in physical activity.

BegSecNew.BegSecText: A new section is added to chapter 28A.230RCW to read as follows:

BillSection.RCWSLText: All public schools must provide to students, in each of gradeskindergarten through twelve, opportunities for at least forty minutesof physical activity each school day, except that where there are fewerthan three instructional hours in a school day, schools must provideopportunities for at least thirty minutes of physical activity each p. 1 SHB 1188school day. Such opportunities may include recess, a physicaleducation class, or other school activities, but must in all instancesallow students to be physically active. The hour must be availableduring instructional hours and may be provided in one block of time orin varying increments throughout the school day. Opportunities toparticipate in school athletic programs, where the activity occursbefore or after instructional hours, do not satisfy this requirement.
